scope.workbook_read_scope: ZIP metadata/shared-string table and first header row only; no numeric spectral vectors constructed.

denominator_correction.rule: The23 errors concern210 held master-TRAIN records, not all350 workbook records. Do not state23/350 as this control error rate.

fold0_competing_explanation.SVC_class_weight: balanced was already used; total class penalties were reweighted. Equalizing sample counts would be a new representation/coverage ablation, not adding class weights for the first time.
fold0_competing_explanation.interpretation: The model jointly faces an unseen dominant jujube source and only six jujube fit specimens from four other sources versus240 acid-kind fit specimens. Source mismatch, poor coverage and preprocessing/measurement effects remain competing explanations. The210/216 denominator concentration means all errors falling inZY01 is not evidence that the entire workbook is acid-kind.

ordinal_description.meaning: Record/sample number position only; no verified measurement-time ordering. Neither filename timestamp nor sample ordinal establishes actual acquisition time.
ordinal_description.posthoc_scope: Bins describe the already observed errors, not a predeclared significance test, contaminant block or causal batch detector. Early ordinal positions contain more errors, but this alone does not identify a mechanism.

header_and_pairing_findings.thickness_interpretation: The350 headers uniformly declare1.5mm. This cannot explain within-ZY01 error differences as a varying header value, and does not verify actual physical thickness or thickness used during absorption inversion. Other sources may have different acquisition/preparation conditions.
header_and_pairing_findings.cross_modality_offset_warning: Time/frequency sample j lies one Excel column to the right of alpha/n sample j because B is a reference waveform/spectrum in time/frequency. Join by explicit parsed sample ID and separate sheet-to-column maps. Never concatenate equal column letters across modalities or treat the reference as a specimen.
header_and_pairing_findings.current_alpha_only_control_qualification: The reviewed existing control reads explicit alpha master-TRAIN columns beginningB and excludes reference/text fields; this newly identified offset risk does not establish a defect in that alpha-only run. Alpha/n are aligned by their paired headers and coordinates in the pinned preparation workflow.
header_and_pairing_findings.source_or_directory_misuse: Current registry/metadata explicitly bindsZY01 to one active Chinese-named workbook. Both newly uploaded aliases were exact duplicate original bytes and add no observations. Paths/names/header IDs are not numerical model features; they are provenance/identity only. Sourcegroup/acquisition confounding can persist despite excluding text predictors.

missing_metadata.consequence: No current record can connect error ordinal positions to instrument/date/batch or measured thickness. The existing Chinese species label remains a user declaration, not independent botanical authentication.

hypotheses_and_minimum_discriminating_wo.hypothesis: Few jujube donors and source-domain coverage
hypotheses_and_minimum_discriminating_wo.support_now: Fold0 uses only6 jujube donors; other held jujube groups are only6 observations in total.187/210ZY01 are nevertheless classified as jujube.
hypotheses_and_minimum_discriminating_wo.minimum_computation: Freeze all25 one-jujube-source×one-acid-source leave-source-pair-out fixed-parameter controls on masterTRAIN. Retain fold0-equivalent donor scarcity; add prespecified acid downsampling with identical held IDs as a separate sample-count/coverage ablation. All transforms fit source only; report true sample counts and group-weighted and specimen-weighted metrics.
hypotheses_and_minimum_discriminating_wo.discriminates: Dependence on which acid source is excluded and on fit-sample amount; not botanical truth. Since balanced class weights already exist, sample-count balancing cannot be sold as first correction of class cost.
hypotheses_and_minimum_discriminating_wo.guard: Every original TRAIN specimen will be held multiple times across25pairs; report uniqueN516 separately from repeated prediction rows, and no independence/p-value claim from pair repeats.

hypotheses_and_minimum_discriminating_wo.hypothesis: Availability of source-matched support rather than global wrong species
hypotheses_and_minimum_discriminating_wo.support_now: No ZY01 labeled specimen was in fold0 fit.
hypotheses_and_minimum_discriminating_wo.minimum_computation: Prespecify fixed disjoint masterTRAIN support/query within heldZY01 (and matched acid source if per-class support is used), maxK and nested support IDs before fitting. Compare K0/1/3/5/10 on the identical locked query; reserve maxK first so query denominator never changes withK. Keep original masterCAL/PRED untouched. Tiny sourcegroups cannot support higherK and must be honestly unsupported.
hypotheses_and_minimum_discriminating_wo.discriminates: Whether a few same-source labels repair source shift; improvement does not certify species and is not leave-source-out after adaptation.

hypotheses_and_minimum_discriminating_wo.hypothesis: Spectral outliers, measurement/preparation heterogeneity or thickness/reference inversion
hypotheses_and_minimum_discriminating_wo.support_now: Errors are dispersed in ordinal positions; all350time headers declare1.5mm; no acquisition metadata exist. No numeric error-vs-correct QC has yet been computed in this audit.
hypotheses_and_minimum_discriminating_wo.minimum_computation: Read only masterTRAIN explicitID alpha/n columns; prespecify numeric QC (finite/axis/header pairing, signal amplitude/bandshape, exact/near duplicates) and descriptive error-versus-correct summaries. Fit any scaler/PCA/selector only on fold fit pools when evaluating a classifier. Preserve all flags and all records; no result-driven exclusions.
hypotheses_and_minimum_discriminating_wo.discriminates: Shape/amplitude extremes or consistent measurement artifacts; not physical species. Header1.5mm is a declared parameter, not independent measured thickness.

hypotheses_and_minimum_discriminating_wo.hypothesis: Cross-modality column/reference mix-up or an alpha-specific numerical artifact
hypotheses_and_minimum_discriminating_wo.support_now: Time/frequency have an extraB reference column; alpha/n do not. Existing alpha-only lookup appears structurally correct.
hypotheses_and_minimum_discriminating_wo.minimum_computation: Header-only ID mapping gate first. For any new TRAIN-only alpha/n comparisons, use equal ID/fold lists and fit per-modality preprocessing on source only; fusion should keep units and modality scaling explicit. Any time/frequency QA must useC-vsB sample maps and exclude the reference. Then compare alpha-only/n-only/fusion with locked parameters, retaining all outcomes.
hypotheses_and_minimum_discriminating_wo.discriminates: Whether disagreements are modality-specific or pairing artifacts. Alpha/n share an acquisition and are not independent physical replicates; agreement does not authenticate labels.

hypotheses_and_minimum_discriminating_wo.hypothesis: Entire workbook or a subset truly belongs to acid-jujube rather than declared jujube
hypotheses_and_minimum_discriminating_wo.support_now: The23 predictions are model outputs under an extreme/source-disjoint fit;187same-group predictions agree with the declared jujube label. Identical uploads and corrected filenames provide no botanical identification.
hypotheses_and_minimum_discriminating_wo.minimum_validation: Do not relabel from classifier output. Authentic independent physical identity/provenance or an appropriately designed morphological/chemical/genetic reference examination is required for a species conclusion; current numeric experiments may only flag candidates for follow-up. Preserve original labels and add a separate suspicion/uncertainty field if necessary.
hypotheses_and_minimum_discriminating_wo.discriminates: This mechanism is not identifiable from self-consistency among models trained on the same unverified Chinese labels.

not_yet_computed: Measured physical thickness or reference-waveform quality for the23 cases.
ID-correct alpha/n/time consistency of the23 cases beyond current header structure.
Independent botanical/chemical/genetic verification or acquisition batch/time mapping.
New25-pair, support-curve or cross-plant control fits; this audit executes none.
conclusion_zh: 23错是210份ZY01留出样品中的23份，不是整本350份被判错，另外187份仍判为枣仁。ZY01占全部枣仁留出数97.22%，而模型拟合只有6份其它来源枣仁，来源/样本覆盖不足是必须竞争检验的解释。错误编号较早段偏多但分散，不能据此认定混种或真实采集时间段。350时域头均声明1.5mm，当前数据缺实际厚度、批次、仪器和日期；跨模态有参考列一位偏移风险，需按ID严格映射。现证据不足以把ZY01改为酸枣仁，先按冻结的TRAIN-only控制区分机制，并保留全部原标签与负结果。
